card.name: Partway through foreign proper names
card.fires_on: The first part of a non-English name or word, often Portuguese, Spanish or French, just before an accented letter or the rest of the name. Seen in plant names, place names and family names.

modes.label: Portuguese plant names
modes.description: The start of a Portuguese folk plant name in quotes, such as erva before a hyphen.

modes.label: Names split before accents
modes.description: A name or word cut just before an accented or non-English letter.

modes.label: Place and family names
modes.description: The opening piece of a river, street or family name from another language.
modes.example: the Banu<< Zu>>hr family who served the Almoh

card.plain: It fires on the early part of foreign-language names, like Portuguese plant names or French place names, before the name is finished.
